lines.trans: So this is your future wife?
She really looks wonderful today.
You Russians have very complicated last names.
My Elena will simply be very happy.
Thank you, when will she come for a fitting?
Unfortunately, she will not be able to come herself.
She is very busy every day right now.
She has constant concerts and filming.
But I will definitely think of something today.
Miss, you have had enough to drink today.
Do not worry about me, Kostya.

examples.trans: Some strange fashion designer checked into the hotel.

examples.text: Я замуж за тебя в нём пойду!
examples.trans: I will marry you in it!

переживать.gloss: to worry, to fret; to go through

meanings.note: Prefix 'пере-' denotes crossing over, repeating, or exceeding a limit (stem 'живать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to worry, to fret; to go through', paired with 'пережить'.

examples.text: Конечно, подменю тебя, не переживай.
examples.trans: Of course, I will cover for you, do not worry.

examples.text: Ты за меня не переживай, Костя.
examples.trans: Do not worry about me, Kostya.

examples.text: А вы не переживаете за показ?
examples.trans: Are you not worried about the show?

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'know'.

examples.text: Ничего себе, я его хорошо знаю!
examples.trans: Wow, I know him very well!

examples.text: Я его хорошо знаю.
examples.trans: I know him very well.

examples.text: Подождите, ваша жена большая знаменитость?
examples.trans: Wait, is your wife a big celebrity?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'колько'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Я знаю, сколько мне можно пить.
examples.trans: I know how much I can drink.

examples.text: Сколько жвачки!
examples.trans: So much gum!

examples.text: Сколько стоит?
examples.trans: How much is it?

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Можно добавить оливковое масло в салат?
examples.trans: Can you add olive oil to the salad?

examples.text: К сожалению, прийти сама она не сможет.
examples.trans: Unfortunately, she will not be able to come herself.

examples.text: Я знаю, сколько мне можно пить.
examples.trans: I know how much I can drink.
